caption: The video captures a wide, near-symmetrical view of a calm lake at golden hour, with the sun resting low on the horizon behind a thin silhouetted tree line. Scattered wispy clouds fill a pale blue-to-orange sky, and a bright vertical reflection of the sun stretches down the mirror-still water below the horizon. A clump of reeds occupies the lower-left foreground. Throughout the view, the sun's disc and the horizon line hold essentially the same image positions, so no measurable rise or set occurs. The diagonal lens-flare streak stays locked to the sun. The bright sun-reflection on the water instead shimmers continuously, its outline subtly reshaping over time as gentle ripples disturb the surface. Soft reflected cloud patches in the lower half waver and morph in step with this small movement, while the high wispy clouds in the upper sky show little visible movement.
